title: 迷上《Formula 1：飆速求生》，於是去了鈴鹿賽道
label: 《Formula 1：飆速求生》

text.Lately, I am really hooked on \"Drive to: 最近我非常沉迷於 Netflix 的 F1 紀錄片《Formula 1：飆速求生》。
text.I have already watched about 5 seasons,: 我已經看了大約五季，整個迷上了。
text.So, since I had the chance, I came to Su: 剛好有機會，所以我就來到鈴鹿賽道。
text.It seems races at Suzuka Circuit are usu: 聽說鈴鹿賽道的賽事通常在週末舉行。
text.Because it was a Friday, there were very: 因為是星期五，現場人很少。
text.Actually, Suzuka Circuit is a race circu: 其實鈴鹿賽道不只是賽車場，也兼有遊樂園。
text.It is a race circuit and an amusement pa: 既是賽車場，也是遊樂園。
text.In Suzuka, even the welcome sign is abou: 在鈴鹿，連歡迎看板都充滿賽車元素
text.As a new F1 fan, I visited the Honda RAC: 身為 F1 新手粉絲，我去了 Honda RACING Gallery，卻還沒能真正興奮起來
